statement: When observation completeness already exceeds threshold and the remaining gaps are scientific, EIG-weighted campaigns should focus on promotion-adjacent mechanisms first.
title: Near-promotion mechanisms should absorb most laboratory bandwidth

statement: Mechanisms that cannot clear observation completeness with approved data sources must be assigned BLOCKED_BY_DATA instead of lingering in RESEARCH.
title: Observation completeness remains a terminal gate for proxy-heavy mechanisms

statement: Temporal stabilization, cross-regime revalidation, and independent replication form a necessary sequence before committee promotion.
title: Promotion requires multi-campaign evidence accumulation
